name: Roland Dimension D SDD-320
description: Roland SDD-320 Dimension D (1979, ET-51B board), R output with the rear INPUT MODE on MONO. Balanced receiver IC101/IC102 (driven unbalanced), IC103 level stage (Q110 gain switch held off), per channel: IC104 pre-emphasis, NE570 compressor half, 2+2-pole transistor anti-alias filter (Q101/Q102), MN3007 BBD biased by VR12 at -7.5 V and clocked by an MN3101 driven by a MC14069UB RC oscillator whose charge current is set by the LFO through D102 (the oscillator is the bbd clock table, fitted in ngspice), VR13 clock cancel, IC109 gain, 2+3-pole reconstruction filter (Q103/Q104), NE570 expander half, IC110 de-emphasis; the R channel's own wet is inverted by IC111 (gain cut by Q111 in mode 4) and summed in IC112 with the direct dry, a 226 Hz low-passed dry (Q105) and the L channel's non-inverted wet; output stage Q106/Q107. Shared LFO: uPC4558 Schmitt + TL082 integrator (triangle 6.8 Vpp / 4 s in modes 1-2, 4.4 Vpp / 2 s in modes 3-4) and TL082 inverter: the R VCO gets the inverted triangle, the L VCO the triangle, through R36/R37 3.9k shorted by Q9/Q10 except in mode 1. Supply: 2 x 23 V peak into a W02 bridge, +/-20 V reservoirs, Q6/Q7 series pass with the 05Z15A reference and Q8 tracking: +/-14 V. Not modelled: level meter (IC1/IC2), bypass/remote logic and relays, L output stage, L input stage (STEREO), BBD supply pins.

Roland SDD-320 owner's manual (July 1981): modes, controls, input/output modes
Panasonic MN3007 1024-stage low-noise BBD datasheet (Xvive reissue): 1024 stages, fcp 10-100 kHz, VDD -15 V, input bias
Panasonic MN3101 two-phase clock generator/driver datasheet: clock frequency is 1/2 of the oscillation frequency
Philips NE570/571 compandor datasheet (internal R1 10k, R2 20k, R3 20k, R4 30k, VREF 1.8 V; compressor/expander configurations)
ON Semiconductor MC14069UB hex inverter datasheet (unbuffered single-stage CMOS; IOL/IOH 8.8 mA typ at VDD 15 V): basis of the ngspice VCO model

controls.label: Dimension mode
controls.note: The four interlocked DIMENSION MODE buttons (1-4, 0-based indices 0..3). Decoded directly by switch positions: S1-a (mode 1: index 0 inserts R36/R37 3.9k; indices 1..3 short them via Q9/Q10), LFO tap (modes 1-2: indices 0..1 select 4 s; modes 3-4: indices 2..3 select 2 s), and S4-c (mode 4: index 3 turns Q111/Q211 on). Default mode 2

controls.label: Input Mode
controls.note: Rear INPUT MODE slide switch. MONO (default here, one guitar input) feeds the R input to both channels through Q4. STEREO leaves the L channel without input (L input stage not modelled)
